target.description: Second law of PROTOCOL 13.4 (docs/wsp/research/phys_efield2.md): the declaration of efield with has_coflow appended (index 7). (PhaseEndTime is the first target with a shared quantity); targets: ion_current, flame_end, peak_ion_current, peak_voltage

features.name: carbon_flow
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.carbon_flow.centre) / x.carbon_flow.scale; refused unless x.carbon_flow.lo <= x <= x.carbon_flow.hi @1

features.name: x_fuel
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_fuel.centre) / x.x_fuel.scale; refused unless x.x_fuel.lo <= x <= x.x_fuel.hi @1

features.name: is_ethylene
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_ethylene.centre) / x.is_ethylene.scale; refused unless x.is_ethylene.lo <= x <= x.is_ethylene.hi @1

features.name: mesh_positive
features.transform: identity: (x - x.mesh_positive.centre) / x.mesh_positive.scale; refused unless x.mesh_positive.lo <= x <= x.mesh_positive.hi @1

features.name: voltage
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.voltage.centre) / x.voltage.scale; refused unless x.voltage.lo <= x <= x.voltage.hi @1

features.name: sweep_v_max

features.name: window
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.window.centre) / x.window.scale; refused unless x.window.lo <= x <= x.window.hi @1

features.name: has_coflow
features.transform: identity: (x - x.has_coflow.centre) / x.has_coflow.scale; refused unless x.has_coflow.lo <= x <= x.has_coflow.hi @1

notes: Generic law forward law.rs, declaration configs/models/law/efield2/decl.json (status Declared): {"slug":"efield2","status":"declared","family":"other","investigation":"PSI-22, ACME E-FIELD Flames: coflow and gas-jet diffusion flames under a burner-to-mesh electric field","description":"Second law of PROTOCOL 13.4 (docs/wsp/research/phys_efield2.md): the declaration of efield with has_coflow appended (index 7).","features":[{"name":"carbon_flow","unit":"1/s","transform":"ln","description":"fuel carbon atoms per second (case input carbon_flow_atoms_s)"},{"name":"x_fuel","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"fuel mole fraction of the fuel stream"},{"name":"is_ethylene","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 when fuel = ethylene"},{"name":"mesh_positive","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 when polarity = positive"},{"name":"voltage","unit":"V","transform":"ln","description":"magnitude of the level's v_cmd; for the targets without a level, the highest magnitude of the sweep"},{"name":"sweep_v_max","unit":"V","transform":"ln","description":"largest magnitude of v_cmd over the programme"},{"name":"window","unit":"s","transform":"ln","description":"window_s of the field programme"},{"name":"has_coflow","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 if u_coflow_m_s > 0, else 0"}],"targets":[{"name":"ion_current","kind":"positive","unit":"A","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"flame current at a planned voltage level, positive in the direction the field drives it, given that the flame still burns (lane-local)"},{"name":"flame_end","kind":"event","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":["blowoff","other"],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"the flame goes out under the field, seconds since the field is switched on; no scheduled stop declared"},{"name":"peak_ion_current","kind":"positive","unit":"A","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"largest current of the sweep (lane-local)"},{"name":"peak_voltage","kind":"positive","unit":"V","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"voltage at which the largest current is reached (lane-local)"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
